description:
At Nakamori Designs, we believe that beauty lies in simplicity and that the environment you create should be a reflection of serenity and elegance. Founded with a passion for minimalist modern Asian aesthetics, we specialize in curating furniture and decor that bring harmony, balance, and sophistication to your living spaces.

Our Story

Nakamori Designs was born from a deep appreciation for the timeless elegance of Asian design principles. Our founders, inspired by the serene landscapes and artistic heritage of East Asia, sought to bring this aesthetic to homes and offices around the world. Located in the heart of Indianapolis, our headquarters serve as the creative hub where tradition meets modernity.

Our Philosophy

At the core of Nakamori Designs is the belief that less is more. Our minimalist approach focuses on clean lines, natural materials, and functional beauty. Each piece in our collection is thoughtfully designed to create a tranquil and inviting atmosphere, transforming spaces into retreats of calm and inspiration.

What We Offer

Our product range includes:

  • Furniture: From sleek, low-profile sofas to elegant dining tables and ergonomic chairs, our furniture pieces are crafted to provide comfort and style.
  • Decor: Discover a curated selection of decor items, including Zen-inspired sculptures, delicate ceramics, and minimalist lighting solutions that add a touch of elegance to any room.

Why Choose Nakamori Designs?

  • Quality Craftsmanship: Our commitment to quality is evident in every piece we offer. We collaborate with skilled artisans and use only the finest materials to ensure durability and lasting beauty.
  • Sustainable Practices: We are dedicated to environmentally friendly practices, sourcing materials responsibly and striving for sustainability in all aspects of our business.


• Payment terms: 30 days
